name: sqlprojectreader-malformed-project-throws
body: Read parses each named .sqlproj with ParseProject, and a malformed project file throws XmlException out of Read, which would abort the whole SQL scan; a .. Build Include that climbs above the repository root resolves to no repository path and matches no file without any report. Upgrade when SchemaEmitter.Run wires Read into the scan: catch the parse failure per project and write a sql: diagnostic instead, treating that project's files as loose.
